answer: The design leans on multi-party computation for private attestation. The copper of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a systems thinking, emergent properties highlighted register, it stays short. A gale of per-task receipts records who did what, and the lotus of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
